response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(s.gbsize) FILTER (WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin) FILTER (WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scans, r.gb_per_minute, r.gb_per_minute - b.avg_gb_per_minute AS exceeds_average_by FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.gb_per_minute > b.avg_gb_per_minute;

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute for a status means total GB divided by total minutes, using only rows with both values present; a zero total duration has no rate.

alternatives.interpretation: GB per minute means the average of individual scan rates within each status.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scans, r.gb_per_minute, r.gb_per_minute - b.avg_gb_per_minute AS exceeds_average_by FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.gb_per_minute > b.avg_gb_per_minute;
